meta.title: Task Butler
meta.description: An AI task secretary for tasks, sessions and self-evolution: the Today workbench answers "what to do today / what needs me" first, with one-line quick capture; the queue auto-claims and runs tasks under a global concurrency limit, and priority now affects queue insertion; a morning brief is generated at 08:30 and pushed to your webhook, followed by a scheduled daily report; new DSH workspace sessions fold in; tasks can be edited, paused, resumed or stopped; scheduled retrospectives turn failures and your corrections into reusable lessons that are archived for review, and fold repeated workflows into DSH skills.
